criteria.reasoning: Logical headings, clear writing, consistent formatting and readable Gantt. Footnote URLs support text. Minor gaps like no figure caption do not impede reading.

technical_issues.issue: States geostationary orbit at 600 km altitude: conflates LEO sun-synchronous-type altitude with GEO (~35,786 km); geostationary cannot be fixed over reef at that altitude.

overall: Strong mission rationale and planning presentation, but preliminary technical work is minimal and contains a major orbit error needing correction in Part 2.

feedback.summary: You presented a strong Great Barrier Reef monitoring concept with clear users and need, and a readable plan with Gantt. Your technical progress is minimal so far and includes an orbit error to fix. Focus next on adding real calculations, contingencies, and sourced planning to stay on track for Part 2.
next_steps: Correct your orbit choice in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress: a geostationary orbit cannot be at 600 km, research LEO vs GEO altitudes and justify coverage of the reef.
Add preliminary results with brief interpretation such as orbit, coverage or link calculations to move beyond STK tutorials 1-4.
Strengthen your Gantt in Image 1 with contingencies and list information sources you will use tied to your mission tasks.

criteria.C1: You did well in Mission Concept & Rationale linking near-real-time relay to help marine scientists predict bleaching, with quantitative context. To keep Accomplished standard, retain clear goals, users and literature links in Part 2.
criteria.C2: Your Gantt in Image 1 and weekly task narrative in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress show feasibility. For Accomplished you need explicit contingencies, why the plan fits your reef mission, and referenced information sources.
criteria.C3: You completed background reading and STK tutorials, but presented no results and stated geostationary orbit at 600 km. For Adequate you need correct orbit analysis plus described results showing you are on track.
criteria.C4: Your report uses logical headings, clear writing and a readable Gantt in Image 1. To stay Accomplished, keep consistent formatting and ensure all figures have captions and references match the text.
